text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday powered through the Japan 
Cup with incredible strength. Her run 
sparkled as brightly as her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheers that echoed on and on— The fans, as 
well as the rivals, all burst into radiant 
smiles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "Marvelous" she had nurtured in this 
world had already expanded to its absolute 
limit.
